newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Fire under control on Taiwanese ship off Australia.
newsitem.headline: Fire under control on Taiwanese ship off Australia.

text.p: A crewman was airlifted to hospital after suffering minor burns when a Taiwanese ship caught fire off the east coast of Australia on Thursday, a port official said.
Port Kembla Port Corporation general manager Philip McGavin said the man was not seriously injured but had been taken to hospital as a precaution.

McGavin said the fire had begun in the accommodation quarters of the unloaded coal carrier, the Ming Mercy, which was anchored five km (three miles) off the Australian coal loading port of Port Kembla.
He said about 20 fireman were needed to bring the blaze under control but it had not been necessary to evacuate the ship.
Port Kembla is around 100 km (62 miles) south of Sydney.
